$comment: Robot classes and carrier types are catalog-like declarations; cohorts and pools are generators of individual robot/carrier entities (each individually declarable and overridable, like any derived entity). Counts here are scaled to the world slice; real Dallas counts in comments.

robot_class.$comment: One carrier at a time — a tote OR a box, never both, per the Dallas ruling. The model string matches the legacy pps.json bot_type for traceability.

lineage.$comment: Who made this product, as its own component rather than a string on the class: one entry here because Dallas buys the K50 from HAI directly and nobody rebrands it. A chain with a distributor and an integrator in it is the cencora shape (SPEC §10.1). What the class can carry and how fast it moves stays flat on robot_class, stated once.

robot_class.$comment: Same chassis as the gripper class, different end effector — hence a different class. 'height' is what the tunnel clearance check reads: 3600 against the tunnel row's lowest level at 4200. OPEN in the calls: which effector serves storage aisles vs the order buffer; swap the two cohort assignments below if this is backwards.

cohort.$comment: Real Dallas: 144. Individual robots expand with keys 'robot:{i}'.
Real Dallas: ~40 working (2 per aisle; interim design splits 20 aisles into 40 one-VTM segments), plus chargers rotating in. Hard assignment: these robots never leave their aisle.
Real Dallas: 8-9 dedicated to the 9 buffer aisles; never crossing over.

carrier_type.$comment: One physical tote type; inventory-vs-order is a per-instance designation (carrier_pool), not a different type. A tray would be this with walls: none.
A box rides the HTM directly (no tray beneath) and leaves the world at extraction.

carrier_pool.$comment: Real Dallas talk: e.g. 800 inventory / 200 order of ~1000 totes; start 50% fill rising to 75%. Designation is permanent per tote (anti-starvation ruling). Individual totes expand with keys 'carrier:{i}' — and any one of them can be declared or overridden by hand for a curated pre-fill.
